description: Look up Florida business entities on Sunbiz by entity name, officer/agent, FEI/EIN, document number, ZIP, address, or trademark. Multiple terms and pasted Sunbiz URLs are supported.

entityStatus.description: Only emit entities with this status. Determined from each entity's detail page.
entityStatus.title: Filter by entity status

entityType.description: Keep only this kind of filing. Useful for hiding trademarks and nearest-name neighbours.
entityType.title: Filter by entity type

includeEventHistory.description: Fetch each entity's full filing-event trail (amendments, mergers, reinstatements, dissolutions, old names). Adds one request per entity that has events.
includeEventHistory.title: Include event and name history

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records across all search terms and URLs. Each record requires a detail-page fetch.
maxItems.title: Max items

mirrorFiledDocuments.description: Save copies of filed documents to Apify storage and add a permanent `pdfUrl` to each `filedDocuments` entry. `all` mirrors up to the 20 newest documents per entity.
mirrorFiledDocuments.title: Filed document PDFs

searchTerms.description: One or more values for the selected `searchType` (entity names, officer/agent names, FEI/EIN digits, document numbers, ZIP codes, street addresses, or trademark terms). Sunbiz matches names/addresses from the start of its ordered index and returns the nearest entries when there is no exact match; `documentNumber` is the only exact lookup.
searchTerms.title: Search terms

searchType.description: Which Sunbiz index to search. Applies to the values in `searchTerms`; pasted `startUrls` are fetched directly.
searchType.title: Search type

startUrls.description: Optional Sunbiz detail or search-results URLs to fetch directly. You can mix URLs with `searchTerms` in one run.
startUrls.title: Sunbiz URLs

title: Florida Sunbiz Business Entity Lookup Input
